# Link Alloy v0.0.1 Alpha

The first functional Link Alloy alpha includes:

- Windows TUN routing with per-connection adapter scheduling.
- Ethernet, Wi-Fi, and USB-tethering adapter health and telemetry.
- IPv4/IPv6 TCP and UDP forwarding for supported unfragmented traffic.
- Protected route cleanup, single-instance locking, and bounded recovery handling.
- A Windows dashboard with Overview, Connections, Activity, and Settings views.

This alpha is intentionally pre-release. Forced-process recovery, physical link-loss failover, and a controlled launcher comparison remain open validation gates. One existing TCP connection remains on one egress link; no speed increase or zero-interruption failover is guaranteed. ICMP and fragmented traffic are outside the current packet path.

The alpha artifact is a portable Windows executable. Run it as administrator and keep it on a writable path so the embedded Wintun runtime can be extracted on first tunnel start. The first release is unsigned; later public releases require the configured Windows signing certificate and timestamp verification.
